entries.task: See what a real application looks like: frontend, backend and database through source, ConfigHub layers and delivery
entries.lesson: Three source manifests describe a frontend, backend and Postgres. A read-only plan shows five proposed ConfigHub Spaces; a local diff changes only the frontend replica field. Neither step writes ConfigHub data or deploys the app.

preview.artifact: JSON plan for three coordinated components and five ConfigHub Spaces

entries.effects: The preview is read-only. Setup creates ConfigHub Spaces, Units and clone links; optional target binding and apply can affect a cluster.
entries.stop_when: Do not claim a deployed or healthy app from the plan. The direct Kubernetes target path needs separate connected and live proof; this preview makes no server or cluster write.

evidence.static: ./setup.sh --explain-json passed locally (three components, five Spaces); local frontend diff found one changed Deployment field /spec/replicas from 1 to 2

practice.artifact: result.json: one changed Deployment field /spec/replicas from 1 to 2
practice.effects: Writes two local copies and a local JSON diff; no ConfigHub or cluster write

local.credentials: none for the plan and local diff
local.cost: Local CPU and temporary disk; no ConfigHub or cluster write
local.cleanup: The plan writes nothing. The diff helper prints a fresh local output directory containing before.yaml, after.yaml and result.json; remove that directory when finished.

connected.credentials: Authenticated compatible ConfigHub context; a Kubernetes target and cluster authority only for the later live path
connected.cost: ConfigHub resource cost unknown; live cluster or cloud cost depends on the selected target
connected.cleanup: After setup, the source ./cleanup.sh deletes the run-labelled ConfigHub Spaces recursively and removes local state; review its scope before running. Live resource cleanup was not checked.

entries.task: Trace an existing Helm value to its source and test one allowed and one blocked governed edit
entries.effects: The command builds cub-gen and makes two commits in a temporary clone under .tmp (or OUT_ROOT). It checks one allowed values edit and rejects one platform-template edit. It does not call ConfigHub or a cluster.
entries.stop_when: A local ownership gate is not ConfigHub approval, promotion or delivery. Umbrella charts, multi-variant fan-out and external values have documented gaps; use separate connected and controller proof for those claims.

evidence.static: Pinned demo-governed-change.sh passed locally: allowed values edit status pass, platform-template edit status fail with exit 2; JSON reports retained in isolated temporary directory

local.credentials: none for the local ownership-gate script
local.cost: Local build CPU and temporary disk; Go dependencies may need downloading if uncached; no ConfigHub or cluster write
local.cleanup: Remove the script output directory under .tmp/helm-paas-governed-change or the chosen OUT_ROOT after reviewing allow/block reports. The script leaves its temporary clone and JSON reports for inspection.

connected.credentials: Authenticated compatible ConfigHub context for the separate connected wrapper; cluster access for the separate runtime wrapper
connected.cost: ConfigHub and optional cluster/cloud cost unknown
connected.cleanup: No connected cleanup was qualified for this indexed local gate; inspect the owning guide before any connected run.
